title: Man dies after being pulled from sea as search continues for two missing off Withernsea
summary: Humberside police confirm death of 67-year-old as rescue operation under way in ‘horrendous conditions’ A man has died as a search continues for two people believed to be missing off Withernsea in the East Riding of Yorkshire. Humberside police confirmed the death of a 67-year-old man, who was pulled from the water unconscious but died later. Continue reading...
